import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv', index_col=False)

# Create a figure and axis object
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Use seaborn's barplot to compare the distribution of megapixels across different sensor types
sns.barplot(x='sensor_type', y='megapixels', data=data, ax=ax)

# Set title and labels
ax.set_title('Megapixels Distribution Across Sensor Types')
ax.set_xlabel('Sensor Type')
ax.set_ylabel('Megapixels')

# Show legend
ax.legend()
